_comment: Supplements Feature Scoring with Bornean Jamides taxa from notebook_data/keys_borneo.txt. Loaded by js/checklist.js alongside tree.json; does NOT alter tree.json, so the ID Key / Direct-path tools are unaffected. Feature keys reference question node ids (existing tree.json ids or the new q_bo_* ids defined below); choice values must match the referenced question's choice labels verbatim.

questions.question: On the hindwing underside, how does the submarginal black spot in space 6 compare with the spots in spaces 4 and 5?
questions.hint: A Bornean character separating philatus (spot 6 about equal to spots 4–5) from aratus (spot 6 quadrate and clearly larger).
choices: Spot 6 about the same size as the spots in spaces 4 and 5
Spot 6 rather quadrate and larger than the other spots

questions.question: Male upperside colour of a wedge-spotted specimen (Bornean philatus subspecies)?
questions.hint: Upperside character separating the two Bornean philatus subspecies; both have androconia.
choices: Bluish white (♀ upperside white, tinged blue)

questions.question: Underside ground colour and hindwing orange tornal area in space 2 (Bornean celeno group)?
questions.hint: Separates celeno lawasa (pale greyish-brown; orange area in space 2 usually under 1 mm) from the zebra / pura pair (greyish-brown; orange area usually over 1 mm).
choices: Pale greyish-brown; orange area in space 2 usually less than 1 mm
Greyish-brown; orange area in space 2 usually more than 1 mm

questions.question: On the hindwing underside, are the postdiscal white striae dislocated at vein 6 (the portion in space 6 shifted basad)?
questions.hint: Bornean character separating zebra zebra (striae dislocated at vein 6) from pura tenus (not dislocated).
choices: Yes — hindwing postdiscal striae dislocated at vein 6
No — hindwing postdiscal striae not dislocated at vein 6

questions.question: On the hindwing underside, is the subbasal white stria in space 7 in line with the striae in the cell?
questions.hint: Bornean character separating virgulatus / puloensis (stria in space 7 in line with the cell striae) from talinga / limes (not in line).
choices: Yes — subbasal stria in space 7 in line with the cell striae
No — subbasal stria in space 7 not in line with the cell striae

questions.question: Male upperside colour and forewing border of a plain-underside specimen (Bornean virgulatus vs puloensis)?
choices: Bright blue; forewing black border regular, about 1 mm; no androconia
Shining white with bluish tints; forewing border a thread; no androconia

_species_comment: Each taxon may set "like": <core species name> to inherit that Malaysian species' canonical feature set (the shared gateway characters — striae style, inverted pattern, wedge spots, band dislocation, etc.); "features" then overrides/adds on top. This keeps a Borneo taxon a live candidate whenever the user answers a shared character consistently, and gives it a full Direct-style path. Taxa with no Malaysian counterpart (virgulatus, puloensis) list every feature explicitly.

species.name: Jamides cyta lividus
species.note: Borneo. Bornean subspecies of J. cyta. Underside as cyta — straight white striae with the spaces between the hindwing inner and outer submarginal striae strongly filled with dark brown. Male upperside whitish violet-blue with long paddle-shaped androconia; ♀ white, tinged blue.

species.name: Jamides philatus armatheus
species.note: Borneo. Bornean subspecies of J. philatus. Forewing band in line; hindwing with prominent wedge-shaped submarginal spots, spot 6 about equal to spots 4–5. Male upperside bluish white, with androconia; ♀ white, tinged blue.

features.q_bo_spot6: Spot 6 about the same size as the spots in spaces 4 and 5
features.q_bo_philatus_upperside: Bluish white (♀ upperside white, tinged blue)

species.name: Jamides philatus amphissyna
species.note: Borneo. Bornean subspecies of J. philatus. As armatheus but male upperside sky blue (♀ white). Hindwing wedge-shaped submarginal spots, spot 6 about equal to spots 4–5.

features.q_bo_spot6: Spot 6 about the same size as the spots in spaces 4 and 5

species.name: Jamides celeno lawasa
species.note: Borneo. Bornean subspecies of J. celeno. Underside pale greyish-brown; hindwing orange area in space 2 usually under 1 mm. Male upperside greyish white, with androconia; forewing black border more than 1 mm in spaces 3–6.

features.q_bo_celeno_ground: Pale greyish-brown; orange area in space 2 usually less than 1 mm

species.name: Jamides zebra zebra
species.note: Borneo. Bornean subspecies of J. zebra. Underside greyish-brown; hindwing orange area in space 2 usually over 1 mm; hindwing postdiscal white striae completely dislocated at vein 6. Male upperside with thread-like forewing border.

features.q_bo_celeno_ground: Greyish-brown; orange area in space 2 usually more than 1 mm
features.q_bo_hw_striae_vein6: Yes — hindwing postdiscal striae dislocated at vein 6

species.name: Jamides pura tenus
species.note: Borneo. Bornean subspecies of J. pura. Underside greyish-brown; hindwing orange area in space 2 usually over 1 mm; hindwing postdiscal white striae NOT dislocated at vein 6. Male upperside with thread-like forewing border.

features.q_bo_celeno_ground: Greyish-brown; orange area in space 2 usually more than 1 mm
features.q_bo_hw_striae_vein6: No — hindwing postdiscal striae not dislocated at vein 6

species.name: Jamides virgulatus virgulatus
species.note: Borneo. Forewing band completely dislocated at vein 4, also slightly dislocated at vein 6; hindwing subbasal stria in space 7 in line with the cell striae. Male upperside bright blue, forewing black border regular about 1 mm, no androconia; ♀ pale sky blue.

features.q_lugine_ground_colour: No — typical pale grey ground colour

features.q_fw_vein6: Yes — band also slightly dislocated at vein 6 (space 6 shifted inward)
features.q_bo_hw_stria7_cell: Yes — subbasal stria in space 7 in line with the cell striae
features.q_bo_virg_pulo_upperside: Bright blue; forewing black border regular, about 1 mm; no androconia

species.name: Jamides puloensis
species.note: Borneo. Forewing band completely dislocated at vein 4, also slightly dislocated at vein 6; hindwing subbasal stria in space 7 in line with the cell striae. Male upperside shining white with bluish tints, forewing border a thread, no androconia; ♀ white.
